title: Student V0.1 JOB 07 R1 — deterministic pilot packaging after served-V4 repair
purpose: Build and independently qualify the smallest deterministic local/offline pilot package around the exact repaired Learn-it Next application, without changing product semantics and without consuming the frozen showcase branch.
invariants: The repaired product is read-only; pilot packaging must wrap exact product bytes rather than fork or patch them.
The package builder is generic over any canonical learnit.kit.v4 input and must not depend on JOB06 showcase output.
The qualification uses the existing repaired-base rich V4 fixture as test input only; it is not pilot content authority.
The distributed package is local/offline and contains no backend, remote catalog, remote script, remote font, service dependency or network-required asset.
The canonical V4 kit may contain scoring authority by design; security claims apply to learner runtime/presentation/DOM, not to a technically inspectable local JSON file.
Browser file-selection steps must be counted honestly; no auto-import or browser-security bypass is allowed.
The package must be byte-deterministic for identical app/kit inputs, including deterministic archive entry order and metadata.
Generated bulky package artifacts are qualification outputs and are not committed unless repository authority explicitly requires it.
No sibling Wave 2 implementation branch is consumed. JOB05 R1 evidence is a gate input only; JOB06 remains frozen.
Any product defect discovered during real packaged-browser use returns HOLD with owner classification; JOB07 R1 does not repair it.
requiredEvidence: Fresh HCP and repository/PR #411 rebind, plus independent verification that JOB05 R1 PASS is durable and PR #413 remains unmerged.
Exact branch ancestry from JOB07_R1_BASE and repaired product anchor.
Canonical repaired application built twice and verified at 478657 bytes / SHA256 85dbeeef4207c9e4deb846d2b2e15f1e6979b1d32144ead3c1097bd5bf15630e before packaging.
Qualification fixture is validated canonically as learnit.kit.v4 before packaging.
A deterministic package builder accepts explicit app HTML and V4 kit paths and emits a bounded package with app, kit, learner start surface/instructions and machine-readable manifest.
Pilot manifest binds exact app bytes/SHA256 and exact kit bytes/SHA256, plus deterministic package format/version metadata.
Two package builds from identical inputs are byte-identical with exact package byte count and SHA256 recorded.
Archive entry order, timestamps/metadata and manifest serialization are deterministic and inspected.
Extracted package app and kit hashes revalidate exactly against the pilot manifest.
Learner start instructions identify learner actions, facilitator/setup actions and recovery/reset actions separately.
Actual learner action count from opening START_HERE to course start is measured without excluding mandatory chooser/selection/import actions.
The unpacked package is exercised through the real app and real product controls with the qualification fixture, not by direct runtime calls.
Desktop 1365x768 and mobile 390x844 complete import/start/interact/reload/resume/completion from the packaged inputs.
No unexpected remote HTTP(S) request occurs during start or rich journey.
Reload/resume and completion survive the packaging context.
Recovery covers invalid kit selection, return-to-library/continue, and documented local reset without claiming cross-device sync.
Learner UI/presentation remains free of hidden scoring keys during packaged use.
Relevant repaired-product and JOB05 R1 regression evidence is rerun or independently checked on exact result head; no prior PASS is accepted by prose alone.
Minimum exact-head CI route executes package determinism and packaged-browser smoke on exact RESULT_SHA.
Repository governance, authoritative PR scope and final changed-path audit pass.
Qualification evidence separates RESULT_SHA from EVIDENCE_HEAD and records package hashes, workflow IDs, changed paths and rollback.
adversarialTests: A deterministic ZIP that cannot start and complete a rich V4 journey cannot PASS.
A package that embeds app bytes differing from the repaired artifact is a hard failure.
A manifest that binds only filenames rather than bytes/hashes is a failure.
Changing the product to reduce learner action count is a scope failure.
Auto-importing a bundled kit by bypassing the real file chooser is forbidden.
Using JOB06 content or JOB05 QA branch files as implementation dependencies is a scope failure.
A package requiring external network access is a failure.
Non-deterministic ZIP timestamps/order/compression metadata are a failure.
A browser automation that skips mandatory learner actions cannot be used to under-report LEARNER_START_ACTIONS.
If file:// behavior differs from loopback HTTP, the difference must be measured and documented; do not silently test a different start mode than the learner instructions.
A product blocker discovered during packaged use returns HOLD_PRODUCT_BLOCKS_PILOT; it is not repaired from pilot scope.
nonGoals: Authoring or reviewing the final showcase kit.
independentReview: The first JOB07 stopped before packaging and therefore contributes blocker evidence, not reusable package implementation.
JOB05 R1 independently accepted the repaired product before this packaging replay was authorized.
The final package must prove its own deterministic/hash/start properties and cannot inherit them from the served-V4 repair qualification.
rollback: Close the JOB07 R1 PR and delete its branch. PR #411, repaired product/evidence heads, JOB05 R1 and frozen JOB06 remain unchanged.
